forward.source: DECLARE n NUMBER := 0; BEGIN FOR i IN 1..3 LOOP n := n * 10 + i; END LOOP; :out := n; END;

reverse.source: DECLARE n NUMBER := 0; BEGIN FOR i IN REVERSE 1..3 LOOP n := n * 10 + i; END LOOP; :out := n; END;

rounding.source: DECLARE n NUMBER := 0; BEGIN FOR i IN -1.5..1.5 LOOP n := n + i; END LOOP; :out := n; END;

empty.source: DECLARE n NUMBER := 0; BEGIN FOR i IN REVERSE 3..1 LOOP n := n + 1; END LOOP; :out := n; END;

outer_bound.source: DECLARE i NUMBER := 3; n NUMBER := 0; BEGIN FOR i IN i..i+2 LOOP n := n + i; END LOOP; :out := n + i; END;
